stem: Which ending result or final point follows “He learned that choosing a gift is not just guessing from what you see.”?
options: At night, even familiar things can make people ask new questions.
It is paying attention, asking questions, and knowing the person better.
Information shared responsibly can help communities ask better questions and demand better answers.
A quiet room becomes better when everyone takes care of it.

本文可直接核對「He learned that choosing a gift is not just guessing from what you see. It is paying attention, asking questions, and knowing…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Information shared responsibly can help communities ask better questions and demand better answers.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「He learned that choosing a gift is not just guessing from what you see. It is paying attention, asking questions, and knowing the person…」，答案為「It is paying attention, asking questions, and knowing the person better.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It is paying attention, asking questions, and knowing the person better.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
